criteria.requirement: Extend Config.from_prefixed_env with opt-in atomic=False and strict=False. Atomic mode stages a deep detached dictionary, parses sorted matching variables and validates nonempty nested path segments plus dictionary intermediates before any self mutation; errors name the full environment key and preserve all prior nested external aliases. Non-strict atomic mode retains text on declared parse ValueError/TypeError; strict atomic raises, and custom loader programming errors propagate. Valid batches commit together. Keep default legacy loading behavior exactly, require strict with atomic explicitly, and do not silently swallow conflicts or call a failed partial batch successful.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
